title: 2026 UK CBAM embodied-emissions and recordkeeping QA controls

sources.title: Carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM): Policy Summary
Keeping records for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)

facts.source_fact: The UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism is due to come into effect on 1 January 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Treat 2026 guidance as pre-commencement preparation and do not mark obligations as already operational.

facts.source_fact: The published CBAM framework covers specified goods from aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, iron and steel sectors.
facts.expected_handling: Apply product and sector scope before assigning CBAM emissions treatment.

facts.source_fact: The policy allows the liable person to use independently verified actual emissions data or default emissions values, subject to the applicable rules.
facts.expected_handling: Record which emissions basis is used for each reported value.

facts.source_fact: The policy summary assigns the main embodied-emissions calculation steps to the producing installation before verification.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve producer-installation provenance for calculated emissions.

facts.source_fact: The liable person reports the emissions intensity of the imported CBAM good to HMRC after the upstream calculation and verification steps.
facts.expected_handling: Separate producer calculation from importer reporting responsibility.

facts.source_fact: The policy summary describes a one-calendar-year monitoring period for actual embodied-emissions calculation.
facts.expected_handling: Attach monitoring-period vintage to actual-emissions data.

facts.source_fact: Actual-emissions calculations use verified emissions data from the monitoring period.
facts.expected_handling: Reject actual-emissions status when verification evidence is absent.

facts.source_fact: Relevant installation emissions must be attributed to production of the CBAM good using the applicable system-boundary and monitoring methodology.
facts.expected_handling: Require production-boundary attribution before using installation totals as product emissions.

facts.source_fact: Relevant non-CO2 gases are converted to carbon-dioxide equivalent using the values specified by the CBAM framework.
facts.expected_handling: Carry gas identity and conversion provenance rather than mixing raw gas mass with CO2e.

facts.source_fact: The calculation combines carbon dioxide and converted carbon-dioxide-equivalent amounts to obtain the relevant total.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve component breakdown where available before aggregation.

facts.source_fact: Importers choosing actual emissions must keep evidence that the reported emissions data has been verified.
facts.expected_handling: Require verification evidence for an actual-emissions basis.

facts.source_fact: Verification evidence is expected from the supplier as a verification report or verification summary containing relevant emissions data.
facts.expected_handling: Record verification-document provenance with the reported intensity.

facts.source_fact: The verification report or summary relevant to the reported emission intensity must be retained for six years under the published recordkeeping guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Attach retention-period requirements to evidence governance.

facts.source_fact: CBAM records must be kept in written or electronic form for six years from the applicable recordkeeping reference date.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve record-format and retention metadata.

facts.source_fact: A default emissions value must be used when actual emissions data is not available to the importer.
facts.expected_handling: Do not fabricate actual values when upstream data is unavailable.

facts.source_fact: A default emissions value must be used when the importer lacks evidence that the reported actual emissions data has been verified.
facts.expected_handling: Downgrade to the permitted default basis rather than accepting unverified actual data.

facts.source_fact: HMRC states that default emissions values for CBAM goods will be set later in 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Do not invent or pre-populate unpublished default values.

facts.source_fact: HMRC states that further guidance on monitoring, verifying and reporting actual emissions will be provided before commencement.
facts.expected_handling: Mark unresolved implementation detail as pending rather than inferred.

facts.source_fact: The recordkeeping guidance states that a fixed penalty of £500 may apply for failure to keep required CBAM records.
facts.expected_handling: Treat penalty information as compliance governance, not an emissions value.

facts.source_fact: The CBAM policy summary states that details may be updated as legislation, notices and guidance develop before commencement.
facts.expected_handling: Apply strict temporal-version control to pre-2027 CBAM rules.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach product, sector, installation and importer-reporting boundary before downstream use.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing installation emissions with product embodied emissions.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach publication date, pre-commencement status and applicable monitoring period.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents draft or future CBAM provisions being treated as already operative.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry source URL, verifier evidence and actual-versus-default basis into derived outputs.
Do not convert imported-goods embodied emissions into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.
